system.description:
11th Level Clan Feature

The Shi Hou clan are often seen as very self-reliant. So instead of reaching a hand out for others to let them down, they instead look inward and ask themselves to do more.

As an Action, by spending 2 Inner Chi, you can summon up to four Clones as if you cast the Shadow Clone Technique Ninjutsu at A-Rank. Clones summoned this way have a number of additional hit points and temporary hit points, equal to your level. These clones regain temporary hit points equal to your level, at the beginning of each of your turns.
